controls.title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
controls.description: Rules for the acceptable use and handling of information and associated assets should be identified, documented, and implemented.

controls.title: Return of assets
controls.description: Personnel and other interested parties should return all organizational assets in their possession upon change or termination of employment, contract, or agreement.

controls.title: Classification of information
controls.description: Information should be classified according to the security needs of the organization based on confidentiality, integrity, and availability requirements.

controls.title: Labelling of information
controls.description: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling should be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme.

controls.title: Information transfer
controls.description: Information transfer rules, procedures, and controls should be in place to protect information transferred within the organization and with external parties.

controls.title: Access control
controls.description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and assets should be established and implemented based on business and security requirements.

controls.title: Identity management
controls.description: The full lifecycle of identities should be managed, including registration, maintenance, and removal of digital identities within the organization.

controls.title: Authentication information
controls.description: The allocation and management of authentication information should be controlled through a formal process, including advising personnel on proper handling.

controls.title: Access rights
controls.description: Access rights to information and assets should be provisioned, reviewed, modified, and removed in accordance with the organization's access control policy.
